persons.name: Adam Anders
persons.bio: Leveraging digital and biotechnology to help farmers, consumers and the environment is my passion. From growing up on a farm to founding a VC fund, there is no better job than to share this passion with inspiring entrepreneurs.

persons.name: Phil Austin
persons.bio: I have always had a passion for questioning the status quo.  For testing boundaries and exploring ideas that break through them to improve on what has come before.

persons.name: Sanjay Birjmohan
persons.bio: Digital transformation is exciting as it revolutionizes industries with technology, enhancing efficiency and innovation. In the food and agriculture sector, it boosts sustainability and food security, crucial for global challenges. With my previous experience in software investing and aerospace engineering I aim to bring fresh perspectives to the field.

persons.name: Brett Chevalier
persons.bio: Humanity is at a compelling crossroads: it has an ever-growing power to solve the mysteries of life and health and rekindle degraded regions. We can leverage biotechnology to increase agricultural efficiency and ensure biodiversity simultaneously. I find that fascinating.

persons.name: Maarten Goossens
persons.bio: Endurance sports excite me because they challenge you with mental and physical ups and downs over a longer time frame.  Anterra gives me similar excitement; our journey is a marathon in which every step counts and success is built over the years.

persons.name: Neira Pekmez
persons.bio: Escaping a war-torn country, I grew up in several different places. And although it was hard sometimes, the experience has taught me the importance of grit and perseverance.

persons.name: Michael Topalian
persons.bio: Growing up in the Peak District, UK, I was surrounded by farms and had natural produce on my doorstep.  I’m grateful that in my professional life, I can apply my skill set to support innovative companies trying to produce better food and make it available to a bigger population.

persons.name: Brett Wong
persons.bio: Food and agriculture are in my DNA. My father is a serial entrepreneur, predominantly in crop genetics, and my family owns and operates several F&A companies ranging from greenhouses to a lab specializing in food and drug analysis. I also lucked out with a sibling who’s the owner and pastry chef of a prize-winning restaurant.
